grammar.label: precise quantifiers — a great deal of, the vast majority, a handful of
grammar.meaning: quantity stated with more precision than much or many

explanation.en: 'A great deal of' and 'a considerable amount of' take uncountables; 'a large number of' and 'a handful of' take countables; 'the vast majority of' works with both. The verb agrees with the noun after 'of', not with the quantifier.
explanation.uz: 'a great deal of' sanalmaydigan, 'a large number of' va 'a handful of' sanaladigan otlar bilan keladi. Fe'l 'of' dan keyingi otga moslashadi.

grammar.positive_example: The vast majority of readers never reach the last page.
grammar.negative_example: The vast majority of readers never reaches the last page.

l1_notes.uz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar farqi o'zbek tilida yo'q, shuning uchun miqdor iborasini tanlash alohida mashq talab qiladi.

grammar.label: register shift — phrasal verb or Latinate verb, contraction or full form
grammar.form: put off / postpone; find out / discover; don't / do not
grammar.meaning: the same proposition, pitched for speech or for a document

explanation.en: English usually offers a spoken and a written version of the same idea: 'put up with' / 'tolerate', 'go up' / 'increase', 'don't' / 'do not'. Neither is better; using the wrong one for the audience is what reads as a mistake.
explanation.uz: Ingliz tilida bir fikrning og'zaki va yozma varianti bo'ladi: 'put up with' / 'tolerate', 'go up' / 'increase'. Biri yaxshiroq emas — noto'g'ri o'rinda ishlatilgani xato sanaladi.

grammar.positive_example: The meeting has been postponed until Thursday.
grammar.negative_example: The meeting's been put off till Thursday, as stated in the contract.

l1_notes.uz: Uslub farqini his qilish uchun har bir juftlikni alohida o'rganish kerak; lug'atdagi tarjima ikkalasi uchun bir xil bo'ladi.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: This is the last one I read before you take it over.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: 'A lot of people' on page two. How many?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: About five hundred out of six hundred.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Then write 'the vast majority'. And 'a handful of schools', not 'a few'.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: There is 'a great deal of evidence' in the next line.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: That one is right, because 'evidence' is never counted. You have learned the hard half.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: The covering note still bothers me. 'We have put the meeting off till Thursday.'

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: In a note to Bobur, that is perfect. In a letter to the ministry, 'postponed until Thursday'.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Neither is better than the other.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Neither is better. Only one fits the reader, and that is the whole of what I have taught you.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then I will keep both and choose.
